'''Uneme Clan''' (采女氏) refers to an ancient Japanese clan that bore the name "Uneme" and served as administrators overseeing court attendants ([[Uneme]]). Initially bearing the title '''Uneme no Omī''', the clan later assumed the title '''Uneme no Asomi'''.

__TOC__
{{clear}}

== Overview ==
The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' records the clan as "Right Capital Divine Lineage, Heavenly Deities, Uneme no Asomi, related to the Ishikami no Asomi. They are descendants of [[Nigihayahi]], with [[Ōminakuchi no Sukune no Mikoto]] as their ancestor." Originally titled with the ''Omī'' Rank, the clan was elevated to ''Asomi'' in the 13th year of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ja|Emperor Tenmu|2=ja|3=天武天皇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenmu|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Tenmu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q335181}} (684 CE).

During the {{ill|Asuka period|en|Asuka period|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}}, notable members included [[Uneme Mareji]], who, alongside [[Nakatomi no Mikeko]] and [[Takamukai no Uma]], supported the succession of {{ill|Emperor Jomei|en|Emperor Jomei|qid=Q329761|lt=Emperor Jomei}} after {{ill|Empress Suiko|en|Empress Suiko|qid=Q298057|lt=Empress Suiko}}'s death.

Another prominent figure was [[Uneme Takera]], a court official during the same period. In the 10th year of Emperor Tenmu's reign, Takera held the Rank of ''Shōkōnige'' (Small Cap, Lower Rank) and served as the Envoy to Silla. In the 13th year, he was dispatched with Prince {{ill|Yoshi Tsutomuo|ja|三野王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mino|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 美努王|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11608781}} to explore sites in {{ill|Shinano Province|en|Shinano Province|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}} for the construction of a new capital. Upon the establishment of the {{ill|Eight Kabane system|ja|八色の姓|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Colors of Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Kabane system|qq=}}, he was granted the ''Asomi'' title. Takera is believed to have died around the 3rd year of {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Empress Jitō}}'s reign. An epitaph erected on December 25 of that year referred to him as "Takera of Uneme, Minister of the Great Court at Asuka Kiyohara, Senior Deputy of the {{ill|benkan|ja|大弁官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbenkan|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}}."

Later, [[Uneme Hiramai]] achieved the Rank of ''Shōgoige'' (Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade).

'''Uneme Clan''' (采女氏, ''Uneme Uji'') was an ancient Japanese {{ill|Clan|en|Clan|qid=Q211503|lt=Clan}} named after "Uneme" (court ladies). The [[kabane]] (hereditary title) of the clan was originally '''Uneme Omi''' and later changed to '''Uneme Ason'''. The clan was a [[Tomonomiyatsuko|Tomobe]] responsible for overseeing {{ill|Uneme|ja|采女|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme|qq=}}.

__TOC__
{{clear}}

== Overview ==
According to the {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}, “Right Capital, {{ill|Shinbetsu|ja|神別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinbetsu|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinbetsu|qq=}}, descendants of {{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|qid=Q60994492|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|qid=Q60994492|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}: Uneme Ason, co-descendants of Ishikami Ason. They trace their lineage to {{ill|Nigihayahi|ja|饒速日命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nigihayahi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q10949054|1=Nigihayahi|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}, whose sixth-generation descendant was {{ill|Oomizuguchi no Sukune|ja|大水口宿禰命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmizuguchi no Sukune|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 大水口宿禰|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11436785}}.” Initially, their kabane was ''Omi,'' but it was changed to ''Ason'' during the 13th year of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ja|Emperor Tenmu|2=ja|3=天武天皇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenmu|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Tenmu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q335181}}'s reign (684) with the {{ill|Eight Kabane system|ja|八色の姓|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakusa no Kabane|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Kabane system|qq=}} reforms.

In the {{ill|Asuka period|en|Asuka period|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}}, {{ill|Q58139695|ja|采女摩礼志|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme Mareishi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q58139695}} supported the selection of {{ill|Emperor Jomei|ja|田村皇子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Prince Tamura|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 舒明天皇|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q329761}} (later Emperor {{ill|Emperor Jomei|en|Emperor Jomei|qid=Q329761|lt=Jomei}}) as the successor to {{ill|Empress Suiko|en|Empress Suiko|qid=Q298057|lt=Empress Suiko}} after her passing, alongside {{ill|Nakatomi no Mikeko|ja|中臣御食子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nakatomi no Mikeko|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11366911}} and {{ill|Q58139701|ja|高向宇摩|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamukai no Uma|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q58139701}}.

Another prominent figure, {{ill|Uneme no Tsukura|ja|采女竹羅|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme Takera|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q57888145}}, served as a {{ill|Shōkin-ge|ja|小錦下|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōninkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11464364}} and envoy to Silla in the 10th year of Emperor Tenmu's reign. In the 13th year, he was dispatched with {{ill|Yoshi Tsutomuo|ja|三野王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Prince Mino|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 美努王|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11608781}} to explore possible locations for a new capital in Shinano Province. During the Yakusa no Kabane reforms, he was granted the title ''Ason.'' He passed away around the 3rd year of Empress {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Jitō}}'s reign. His tombstone, erected on December 25 of the same year, described him as “{{ill|benkan|ja|大弁官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dainikan|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}} of Asuka Clean Plain Grand Court, Chokudaifu Uneme Takera Lord.” His name also appears as ''Chikura'' or ''Takeyoshi.''

Later, {{ill|Q17217390|ja|采女枚夫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme Hikafu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17217390}} rose to the Rank of ''Shōgoi no Ge'' ([[Senior Fifth Rank]], Lower Grade).
